title: Concept: Build tooling declared as a runtime crate
description: Cargo.toml declares a build-script crate in the runtime dependency table, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a build-script crate in the runtime dependency table.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a build-script crate in the runtime dependency table.
